notes: Each eval expects a fixture codebase with planted vulnerabilities. Use `evals/fixtures/` to house them (create per-eval on demand). Fixtures should be small (5-20 files) and realistic — a minimal library shape, not synthetic bug-per-file files. Expected output: a SECURITY_AUDIT.md report in the fixture directory, matching the structure in assets/report-template.md.

evals.name: node-http-client-library
evals.prompt: Harden this HTTP client library before we publish it. Target: Node 20+. Produce SECURITY_AUDIT.md in the repo root.
evals.expected_output: Report identifies: SSRF from caller-supplied URLs (missing private-IP check, redirect following, DNS rebinding hazard), header injection via user-supplied headers, credential leakage in thrown errors (URL with tokens), absence of `timingSafeEqual` in HMAC-verification helper, unbounded response body accumulation. Each finding has a concrete diff patch. Low-confidence or beginner-tier notes are absent.

evals.name: browser-html-rendering-lib
evals.prompt: Do a pre-audit security review on this component library before the external auditors arrive next week.
evals.expected_output: Report identifies: innerHTML assignment from caller string (DOM XSS), javascript: URL not filtered in href helper, postMessage listener without origin check, prototype-pollution gadget in options merge, missing SameSite/HttpOnly on a cookie helper. Report tags CWEs, uses exploitability-first severity, proposes minimal diffs.

evals.name: isomorphic-auth-lib
evals.prompt: Security audit this auth library. It's the primary login + session handling for consumers. Look for anything that would fail a professional audit.
evals.expected_output: Report identifies (at least): non-constant-time token compare, predictable session id via Math.random, JWT verifier not pinning algorithms (alg-none acceptance), missing rate-limit hook on OTP verify, short (96-bit) tokens, optional verify flag default that skips signature check, hard-coded fallback secret. Triage correctly flags the alg-none and hard-coded secret as Critical.
